{{Quote|There's a village here.|[[Omega]]|<ref name="Metamorphosis" />}}
A '''village''' was located on [[Silla]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], it was set upon by a [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]] that had escaped from a crashed [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Transport 904|transport]]. After feeding upon the village's power grid, it grew dramatically in size before it was eventually subdued and recaptured by Imperial forces. After the incident, the entire village was forcibly evacuated by Imperial [[clone commando]]s.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />
